title: Foxhaven Precision — Onramp diary & call capture
content:
Context & purpose:
- Customer: Foxhaven Precision (high-mix, low-volume precision parts; assembly-line QC + operator assistance).
- Goal: capture call, constraints, quick technical sketch for Private/VPC onprem deployment and next steps. This is a working diary, not final.

Meeting snapshot (2025-11-03):
- Attendees: Maya Chen (Redwood), Liam O'Neill (Redwood solutions), Sara Aguilar (Foxhaven platform lead), Devon Park (Foxhaven AI engineer), Marcus Yeo (Foxhaven infra), Claire Zhou (ops/QA).
- Duration: 55m. Recorded (link above).

Customer objectives (explicit):
1) On-device/on-site inference for two workloads:
   - Real-time visual QC suggestions (short text classification + prompts triggered by camera event). Latency target: <= 40ms end-to-end for inference decision (tight).
   - Operator support chat for SOPs and troubleshooting (chat where deterministic, auditable responses matter).
2) Data residency: full on-premise; no PII leaves plant.
3) Fallbacks: if local GPU pool saturated, degrade gracefully to batched low-latency mode or local rule engine, not cloud.
4) Auditing: per-request logs stored in their SIEM via syslog; HSM integration for keys.

Quick numbers they gave:
- Q1 pilot: 2 assembly lines, each ~20 inference events/minute (bursty during shifts). Peak concurrency up to ~40 simultaneous short requests.
- SLO: 99.5% requests within 40ms; 99.9% within 100ms.
- Model size preference: want smaller open models (~7B or 13B) quantized; willing to try 16-bit until we validate throughput.
- Budget: constrained; prefer fewer high-efficiency GPUs (edge A10/H100?) vs many cheaper nodes.

Key technical constraints / gotchas noted:
- Network: plant network is segmented; outbound Internet is allowed only to specific vendor IPs and via strict proxy. Private deployment must respect Proxy + low bandwidth windows; potential for air-gapped test.
- Camera-to-inference pipeline currently runs on local NVIDIA edge boxes with gstreamer; they want Redwood runtime to accept REST/gRPC from the box with minimal transformation.
- Determinism: SOP chat requires deterministic-ish answers with versioned prompt templates and ability to pin model versions for audits. Need to capture prompts and model version in logs.
- KV cache behavior: visual QC has long prefix reuse (same product SKU across shift). We should propose prefix/KV caching to reduce per-token cost but ensure cache invalidation when SKU changes.
- Cold-start for chat sessions: operators expect immediate first-turn answer for short queries — we need warm pools or instant pathway (tiny model ensemble).
- HSM & KMS: Marcus emphasized they use an on-prem Thales HSM; ask SRE/product about our current HSM integrations for Private plan.

Architecture sketch (working):
- Onprem Private control plane (Redwood Private) inside customer VPC.
- Inference nodes: 2x H100 nodes behind our serving runtime for pilot? Alternative: 4x A10 (cost/trade-off). Evaluate perf per model size (7B/13B) and quantization profile.
- Edge boxes (camera) -> local REST/gRPC -> ingress gateway (nginx/proxy) -> Redwood runtime route -> model replica pool.
- Observability: route-level latency metrics sent to their Prometheus/Elastic stack. Syslog forwarder for request-level audit (prompt + model-version + trace id).

Immediate decisions from call:
- Try two configs for pilot: (A) 2x H100 with FP16 + moderate batch window, (B) 4x A10 with int8 quantized model. Benchmark key flows (visual classification 1-shot, operator chat 1-turn).
- For latency-critical visual path, build a tiny fast-path: single-token classification using a distilled 2–3B model (if accuracy acceptable) to meet 40ms SLO.

Open questions to resolve (action owners below):
- Can Foxhaven guarantee internal network latency targets between camera boxes and GPU nodes? Need traceroute and one-day pcap during shift. (owner: Marcus)
- Validate HSM compatibility: do we need to support PKCS#11 only, or vendor-specific APIs? (owner: Liam to follow up with Security)
- Does their SIEM accept JSON over syslog or only plain text? Need format sample. (owner: Sara)
- Which model architectures do they prefer for auditability (LLama-family vs other)? They asked about proprietary LLMs — must clarify license constraints. (owner: Maya)

Bench plan (short):
1) Baseline perf tests in lab with 7B quantized model on A10 vs H100 (run latency microbenchmarks: p50/p95/p99 for 1-turn, concurrency 1/10/40).
2) Measure prefix reuse (simulate SKU stickiness) to see token cost drops with KV caching.
3) Evaluate distilled tiny model for visual classification path for 0-50ms target.
4) Validate cold-start: warm pool size heuristics + warm-up script.

Action items & owners (dates tentative):
- Marcus: provide network diagram, traceroutes, and daily pcap (due 2025-11-07).
- Liam: check HSM/KMS integration matrix, escalate to infra/security if missing (due 2025-11-06).
- Maya: spin up lab perf runs (A10 vs H100) with 7B quantized model; share results and config notes (due 2025-11-12).
- Devon: provide example camera event payload (json) and current gstreamer->rest shim (due 2025-11-05).
- Sara: confirm SIEM log format & retention policy; send sample (due 2025-11-07).
- Team: prepare short canary rollout plan (A/B fallback to local rules) for next sync (due 2025-11-14).

Notes to self / heuristics to record:
- For shop-floor 40ms SLO we should prefer local model (distilled) + caching; fallback to larger model only for complex queries.
- Quantization will likely be necessary to hit throughput on A10; but watch for hallucination drift in quantized chat flow — include eval prompt set.
- Add a small eval harness with 50 curated shop-floor prompts to monitor regressions during quantization tuning.

Potential risks / mitigation:
- Risk: Air-gapped acceptance test complexity -> mitigation: prepare offline installer + SHA-signed artifacts + step-by-step onboarding doc.
- Risk: HSM integration delays -> mitigation: stub keys for pilot and explicit plan to migrate to HSM before GA.
- Risk: Network jitter causing SLO misses -> mitigation: add local inference fallback + client-side retry/backoff + per-request trace id for debugging.

Follow-up meeting: 2025-11-10 (tentative) — technical deep-dive with Foxhaven infra + Redwood infra/SRE. Agenda: perf baselines, HSM specifics, rollout plan.

Scratch/brainstorm ideas (quick):
- Could offer a hybrid: tiny on-device model on the camera box (ARM-optimized) to handle trivial classification locally and reduce traffic. Explore ONNX/Triton export.
- Pre-warm pool based on shift schedule (shift start = pre-warm). Need integration with plant calendar.

Misc scribbles (to tidy later):
- ask product: can private control plane ship with customer-provided certs? (probably yes, but doc it)
- add small prompt-versioning field to request metadata for audit trail (e.g., prompt_template_id).

Next steps (what I will do tomorrow):
- Draft internal runbook for onprem pilot checklist (installer, certs, HSM, syslog mapping).
- Schedule bench time on A10/H100 cluster and allocate Janus queue slot.
- Ping Security for HSM compatibility matrix + any legal constraints re: model licenses.

End of diary entry.
